checks.description: 2 entry point(s) take in underlying asset and issue vault share in the same transaction: Vault.deposit(assets, receiver), Vault.mint(shares, receiver)
In Vault.deposit(assets, receiver): Any account pays underlying asset (assets); `receiver` argument of deposit() receives vault share (shares) — payer and share receiver are different parties
Vault.withdraw(assets, receiver, owner) burns vault share and pays out underlying asset

Any account calls Vault.withdraw(assets, receiver, owner); vault share is burned from `owner` argument of withdraw(); underlying asset is paid to `receiver` argument of withdraw() — shares are burned from a party other than the caller
Payout amount (assets) data-depends on the burned amount (shares)
Exit path stays within analysed code
